snippet.title: Dead Dock Protocol – The D0K Went Rogue | Official Story Trailer
snippet.description:
Introducing Dead Dock Protocol, a thrilling cyberpunk zombie shooter packed with intense, neon-blood-soaked action! Embark on a crucial mission to rescue six besieged city zones from the clutches of Zombots and their formidable bosses. Whether you fight alongside your team or venture alone, your objective is to stay alive and eradicate the hordes of Zombots. Prepare for a pulse-pounding experience as Dead Dock Protocol launches on Steam and the cutting-edge Steam Deck platform in 2026.


Wishlist Today @ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3074330/Dead_Dock_Protocol/
